edition.notes: The official Latin text of the four responsa as printed under Ex Commissione Biblica, with the notice that Pope Pius X approved them and ordered their publication.
edition.title: De Mosaica authentia Pentateuchi

passages.context: Responsa I-IV reject the claim that the arguments offered establish a substantially post-Mosaic Pentateuch; distinguish Mosaic authorship from writing every word personally or by dictation; permit Moses' use of written documents and oral traditions; and permit inspired post-Mosaic additions, glosses, linguistic updating, and scribal errors while maintaining substantial Mosaic authenticity and integrity.
